The left chart’s categories are 生活工作, 生产, 身体动作, 社交, 其他, 生理活动, 文教, 战争; the description duplicates 战争 and omits 文教.

errors.text_span: 右侧的图表进一步将“其他”类别细分为11个子类别
errors.evidence: The right pie chart shows 10 subcategories, not 11.

The right chart includes 10 categories: 帮助, 表情, 方位改变, 际遇, 交通, 判断, 社交, 身体动作, 生产, 生活工作, 生理活动, 司法, 文教, 物态事态, 心理活动, 战争, 争斗. The description omits several labels, invents '司法' as 10.64% and '斗争' instead of '争斗', and lists only 10 items while the inset chart has 10 slices but the text claims 11.
